title:
Your food diary.
In ChatGPT.
subtitle: Connect once, then log meals and check your daily totals from a conversation.

availability.title: Submitted for ChatGPT review
availability.message: GainFrame is awaiting OpenAI approval. Food chat is available in supported iPhone beta builds. Public availability is coming after approval.

steps.title: Find GainFrame in ChatGPT
paragraphs: Once the listing is approved, open GainFrame in ChatGPT and choose Connect to open GainFrame on your iPhone.

steps.title: Approve your diary connection
paragraphs: Sign in with your usual Apple or Google account if needed. Tap Connect and sync diary to approve access once.
Using ChatGPT on a computer? Copy the connection code from its linking page and enter it in Settings → Integrations → ChatGPT → Connected diary.

steps.title: Say what you ate
paragraphs: In ChatGPT, select GainFrame and try “Log two eggs for breakfast” or “What have I logged today?”
Check the saved receipt. Say “Make that three eggs” to correct it. ChatGPT may show its own permission prompts.

connectionButtonHint: Enter a connection code or manage diary sync
privacyText: Only your synced food diary is shared. Body photos, Apple Health records, and Coach conversations stay private.
managementText: Manage access in Settings → Integrations → ChatGPT.
